para(c,'Dear Lena and Reginald:')
para(c,'On behalf of Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC (“Pinnacle”), we attach Pinnacle’s second-turn counter-redline of the Deposit Account Control Agreement covering Graycliff Industries, Inc.’s three deposit accounts at Ironbridge National Bank, N.A. (accounts ending 4471, 4472, and 4473). The approximate aggregate controlled balance is $38,150,000. We have reviewed Ironbridge’s May 5, 2025 markup and have addressed each of the substantive changes identified in your transmittal. Our comments below are intended to facilitate a prompt path to execution well before the May 30, 2025 delivery and perfection deadline under Section 6.14(b) of the Credit Agreement.')
para(c,'Pinnacle’s positions are as follows:')

items=[
('1. Entitlement-order terminology (§ 2(a)).','We have restored “Entitlement Order” terminology alongside the Article 9 “Instruction” terminology. This is deliberate: the agreement should preserve the Article 8 control framework if an Account is characterized as a securities account, while also satisfying the Article 9 tripartite-agreement method. The dual-track formulation is intended to ensure that the Bank’s agreement to follow Secured Party directions is effective without further Depositor consent and without ambiguity as to UCC Article 8 control.'),
('2. Springing exclusive control and ordinary-course operation (§ 2).','Pinnacle accepts the concept that Graycliff may operate the Accounts in the ordinary course before a Notice of Exclusive Control (“NOEC”) is delivered. We have clarified the boundary that is essential to the control arrangement: upon the Bank’s receipt of an NOEC, Graycliff may not issue or continue to issue new directions, and the Bank must comply exclusively with Pinnacle’s directions without a Depositor-consent condition. This preserves ordinary-course functionality while making the post-NOEC lock-down unqualified.'),
('3. Conflicting-instructions waterfall and Bank priority (§ 3).','We have rejected the proposed priority for Bank set-off and liens over Pinnacle’s directions. In a conflict, Pinnacle’s Instructions and Entitlement Orders must prevail. That priority is central to the control arrangement and to the UCC framework: the Bank’s authenticated agreement to follow the Secured Party’s directions is the basis for control under UCC § 9-104(a)(2).'),
('4. Set-off scope (§ 4).','As a good-faith accommodation, Pinnacle has narrowed the Bank’s set-off rights rather than insisting on an absolute waiver. The permitted carve-out is limited to direct, matured, liquidated obligations arising under the deposit account agreements themselves—customary account fees, service charges, and returned or reversed items. It excludes contingent, unmatured, unliquidated, derivative, swap, foreign-exchange, credit-facility, and Affiliate obligations. Any permitted set-off remains subject to Pinnacle’s priority and the subordination provisions.'),
('5. NOEC compliance period (§ 5).','We have countered the proposed five-business-day period with three Business Days. This is a reasonable middle ground between the two-business-day period in Pinnacle’s form and Ironbridge’s five-business-day request. It gives the Bank a meaningful operational window while limiting the period during which funds could be dissipated after an NOEC.'),
('6. Indemnification / gross negligence (§ 6).','The proposed indemnification for the Bank’s own gross negligence is rejected. Pinnacle has restored the customary carve-outs for gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, and material breach. A secured party should not be required to indemnify a depository bank for losses caused by the bank’s own gross negligence; that allocation is consistent with market practice for control agreements.'),
('7. Aggregate liability cap (§ 7(a)).','The proposed $50,000 aggregate cap has been deleted. The three controlled Accounts hold approximately $38.15 million, so a $50,000 cap would be de minimis in relation to the collateral at risk and would provide no meaningful accountability for a control failure. Pinnacle cannot accept that cap in its current form.'),
('8. Consequential-damages waiver (§ 7(b)).','We have left the mutual consequential, punitive, incidental, and indirect damages waiver in place for this turn, subject to Pinnacle’s reservation of rights and the resolution of the remaining Section 7 issues. Pinnacle is not making a separate objection to a properly mutual waiver in principle, but the waiver should not be viewed as curing or replacing the deleted liability cap or as limiting direct losses arising from a failure to honor the control mechanics.'),
('9. Bank-lien subordination / lookback (§ 8).','We have changed the proposed 90-day Lookback Period to 180 days. A shorter period would leave an unacceptable gap in the subordination protection during which older Bank claims could prime the Secured Party’s interest in the Accounts. We have also conformed the fee language so that only the expressly permitted ordinary-course items receive the limited carve-out.'),
('10. Termination rights (§ 9).','Pinnacle continues to prefer termination only with Secured Party consent. As a practical counter-proposal to the Bank’s unilateral termination right, the redline provides for at least 90 days’ prior written notice and expressly permits Pinnacle to transition the Accounts to a replacement depository bank during that period. Ironbridge must cooperate, and termination should not become effective until replacement control documentation is executed and control is perfected. A 30-day unilateral termination right could create an avoidable gap in perfection.'),
('11. Governing law and related forum provisions (§ 10).','We have restored New York law and the related New York forum provision. New York law governs the Credit Agreement and provides a well-developed body of authority concerning UCC Articles 8 and 9 control arrangements. The provision separately recognizes that mandatory local-law rules governing perfection and priority under UCC § 9-304 will control where applicable.'),
('12. No prior control agreements or liens (§ 12).','We have reinstated the representations addressing prior control agreements, liens, and adverse claims, together with the forward-looking covenant not to enter into another control arrangement without Pinnacle’s consent. This confirmation is critical to Pinnacle’s first-priority control analysis. A public UCC search will not identify a competing control agreement, so the Bank’s representation is an important protection against an undisclosed competing arrangement.'),
('13. Successor-bank notification (§ 9.1).','We have reinstated an obligation to provide at least 30 days’ prior written notice of any merger, consolidation, transfer of substantially all deposit-taking operations or assets, or transfer of the Accounts to a successor bank. The Bank must also cause the successor to assume the ACA obligations and cooperate in executing replacement control documentation. This notice is necessary to preserve continuity of the control arrangement and avoid a perfection gap.'),
]
for title, body in items:
    p=para(c,title,bold=True); p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(7); p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2)

para(c,'Fees (§ 11).',bold=True)
para(c,'Pinnacle accepts the annual maintenance fee of $3,500 per Account ($10,500 in the aggregate for the three Accounts). para(c,'Please let us know if a call would be helpful. We are prepared to work constructively toward a final form and believe the attached markup narrows the remaining issues while protecting the essential control and perfection mechanics.')
para(c,'Best regards,')
para(c,'/s/ Priya Nagarajan\nPriya Nagarajan\nHargrave Stein & Collier LLP\nCounsel to Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC')
para(c,'cc: Catherine Voss, Dunlevy Rourke LLP (counsel to Graycliff Industries, Inc.)\n    Diana Whitford, Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC\n    Jonathan Kehoe, Ironbridge National Bank, N.A.')

For instance, there’s a connection from Business Day in Charlotte to New York regarding the governing rules. I'll reference UCC from NC to NY and see what else remains relevant. Section 2: 2.1 specifies that a bank refers to a deposit account only, but maybe I could include "and/or securities account" considering Article 8.

**Considering jurisdiction changes**

The instructions don’t specifically mention the venue for the changes, but the user's request is clear: they're looking for guidance on each substantial change. The bank's full markup appears to shift jurisdiction from New York to Mecklenburg, NC, in the governing-law section. I think it might be wise to counter-propose that New York courts remain the chosen venue, although the client's directives only reference the governing law and not the venue itself.

from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK

import os

OUT='output'

# ---------- shared formatting ----------
def set_cell_shading(cell, fill):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = tcPr.find(qn('w:shd'))
    if shd is None:
        shd = OxmlElement('w:shd'); tcPr.append(shd)
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill)

def set_cell_margins(cell, top=80, start=100, bottom=80, end=100):
    tc = cell._tc; tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcMar')
    if tcMar is None:
        tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar'); tcPr.append(tcMar)
    for m, v in [('top', top), ('start', start), ('bottom', bottom), ('end', end)]:
        node = tcMar.find(qn('w:'+m))
        if node is None: node = OxmlElement('w:'+m); tcMar.append(node)
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(v)); node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')

def set_repeat_table_header(row):

def add_page_number(paragraph):

    fldChar2 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'end')

def base_doc(title=None):

    sec.top_margin=Inches(0.7); sec.bottom_margin=Inches(0.7); sec.left_margin=Inches(0.85); sec.right_margin=Inches(0.85)
    styles=d.styles
    normal=styles['Normal']; normal.font.name='Times New Roman'; normal._element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'),'Times New Roman'); normal.font.size=Pt(10.5)
    normal.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(5); normal.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.05
    for sname, size, bold in [('Title',16,True),('Heading 1',12,True),('Heading 2',11,True),('Heading 3',10.5,True)]:

        st.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(8); st.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4)
    # footer
    footer=sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; footer.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

def set_track_revisions(doc):
    settings=doc.settings._element
    tr=OxmlElement('w:trackRevisions'); settings.append(tr)
    rv=OxmlElement('w:revisionView'); rv.set(qn('w:ins'), '1'); rv.set(qn('w:del'), '1'); rv.set(qn('w:formatting'), '1'); settings.append(rv)

def add_run_text(par, text, bold=False, italic=False, underline=False, color=None, strike=False):

def add_tracked_segment(par, kind, text, bold=False, italic=False):

        return add_run_text(par,text,bold=bold,italic=italic)
    wrapper=OxmlElement('w:ins' if kind=='ins' else 'w:del')

    wrapper.set(qn('w:date'),'2025-05-09T17:00:00Z')

    r=OxmlElement('w:r'); rPr=OxmlElement('w:rPr')
    rFonts=OxmlElement('w:rFonts'); rFonts.set(qn('w:ascii'),'Times New Roman'); rFonts.set(qn('w:hAnsi'),'Times New Roman'); rPr.append(rFonts)
    sz=OxmlElement('w:sz'); sz.set(qn('w:val'),'21'); rPr.append(sz)
    if bold: rPr.append(OxmlElement('w:b'))
    if italic: rPr.append(OxmlElement('w:i'))
    if kind=='ins':
        col=OxmlElement('w:color'); col.set(qn('w:val'),'0000FF'); rPr.append(col); rPr.append(OxmlElement('w:u'))
        t=OxmlElement('w:t')
    else:
        col=OxmlElement('w:color'); col.set(qn('w:val'),'C00000'); rPr.append(col); rPr.append(OxmlElement('w:strike'))
        t=OxmlElement('w:delText')
    t.set(qn('xml:space'),'preserve'); t.text=text
    r.append(rPr); r.append(t); wrapper.append(r); par._p.append(wrapper)
    return wrapper

def para(doc, text='', style=None, align=None, bold=False, italic=False):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    if align is not None: p.alignment=align
    if text: add_run_text(p,text,bold=bold,italic=italic)
    return p

def redline_para(doc, segments, style=None, align=None, before=0, after=5):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    if align is not None: p.alignment=align
    p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(before); p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(after); p.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.05
    for seg in segments:
        if isinstance(seg,str): kind,text='normal',seg
        else: kind,text=seg
        add_tracked_segment(p,kind,text,bold=(style in ['Heading 1','Heading 2','Heading 3']))
    return p

def bullet(doc, text):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style='Normal'); p.style='Normal'; p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Inches(0.25); p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent=Inches(-0.15)
    add_run_text(p,'• ',bold=True); add_run_text(p,text); return p

def add_redline_heading(doc, segments, level=1):
    return redline_para(doc,segments,style='Heading '+str(level),before=8,after=4)

def add_redline_body(doc, segments): return redline_para(doc,segments,style='Normal')

add_redline_heading(d,['RECITALS'],1)
add_redline_body(d,['WHEREAS, Depositor maintains the deposit accounts identified on Schedule A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (collectively, the “Accounts” and each individually, an “Account”);'])
add_redline_body(d,['WHEREAS, Secured Party has been granted a security interest in, and lien upon, the Accounts and all funds and proceeds credited thereto pursuant to that certain Credit Agreement dated as of April 14, 2025, with a maturity date of April 14, 2030, and the related Loan Documents;'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','WHEREAS, the Parties desire to establish “control” (as such term is defined and used in '),('del','Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of North Carolina'),('ins','Articles 8 and 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of New York'),('normal',') by the Secured Party over the Accounts in order to perfect the security interest of the Secured Party therein;')])

add_redline_body(d,['NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, representations, and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 1 — Definitions'],1)
add_redline_body(d,['As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Loan Documents or, if not defined therein, in the UCC.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Account” or “Deposit Account” means each deposit account identified on Schedule A hereto, including any and all renewals, replacements, or successor accounts thereof, and all funds, cash, instruments, investment property, and other property at any time credited to, deposited in, held in, or otherwise attributable to any such account, together with all interest, income, earnings, and proceeds thereof.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Bank Obligations” means ',('del','any and all obligations owed to Bank by Depositor, whether direct or contingent, now existing or hereafter arising, whether or not related to the Accounts'),('ins','only direct, matured, and liquidated obligations owed by Depositor to Bank arising under the deposit account agreements governing the Accounts, consisting solely of customary account fees, service charges, and returned or reversed items, and excluding any contingent, unmatured, unliquidated, derivative, swap, foreign-exchange, credit-facility, or Affiliate obligation') ,'.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Business Day” means any day on which Bank is open for the conduct of substantially all of its commercial banking business at its offices in ',('del','Charlotte, North Carolina'),('ins','New York, New York'),', excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and any day on which banking institutions in the State of New York are authorized or required by law or executive order to close.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Entitlement Order” has the meaning ascribed to such term in UCC Section 8-102(a)(8), and includes any notification communicated to Bank directing the transfer, redemption, liquidation, or other disposition of a financial asset or interest therein, including any entitlement order originated by Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Event of Default” means an “Event of Default” as defined in, and determined in accordance with, the Loan Documents, or as otherwise notified by Secured Party to Bank pursuant to a Notice of Exclusive Control. Bank shall have no obligation or duty to independently determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Exclusive Control Notice” or “Notice of Exclusive Control” (each, a “NOEC”) means a written notice delivered by Secured Party to Bank in accordance with Section 5 hereof, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A (if any), asserting that an Event of Default has occurred under the Loan Documents and directing Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, and to cease complying with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Instructions” means any order, direction, instruction, request, or authorization regarding the disposition of funds in, or any other action to be taken or omitted with respect to, any Account.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Lien” means any security interest, lien, charge, encumbrance, claim, right of set-off, banker’s lien, or other interest or right of any kind, whether arising by contract, operation of law, or otherwise.'])
add_redline_body(d,['“Loan Documents” means, collectively, the credit agreement, loan agreement, security agreement, and all related agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents between or among Depositor and Secured Party, as amended, restated, supplemented, replaced, refinanced, or otherwise modified from time to time.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','“UCC” means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of '),('del','North Carolina'),('ins','New York'),('; provided that, to the extent that mandatory law governs perfection, effect of perfection or non-perfection, or priority in another jurisdiction, the UCC of that jurisdiction shall apply solely for those purposes.')])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 2 — The Accounts; Establishment of Control'],1)
add_redline_body(d,['2.1 Confirmation of Accounts. Bank hereby confirms and acknowledges that (a) each Account listed on Schedule A is maintained at Bank, (b) each Account is held in the name of Depositor as account holder of record, (c) each Account constitutes a “deposit account” and/or “securities account” (as applicable) within the meaning of the UCC, and (d) Bank is the “bank” within the meaning of UCC Section 9-102(a)(8) with respect to each Account.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','2.2 Establishment of Control. Bank hereby agrees that, from and after the Effective Date, it will comply with '),('del','Instructions'),('ins','Entitlement Orders and Instructions'),('normal',' originated by Secured Party directing the disposition of funds in the Accounts without further consent of Depositor, thereby establishing “control” by Secured Party over the Accounts within the meaning of UCC Sections 9-104(a)(2) and 8-106 (to the extent applicable). Such compliance obligation is unconditional and shall not be subject to any condition other than delivery in accordance with Section 10. The Parties intend that this Agreement satisfy all requirements for control and perfection under the UCC.')])
add_redline_body(d,['2.3 No Changes to Accounts Without Consent. Bank shall not, without the prior written consent of Secured Party, change the name, account number, title, designation, or ownership of any Account; close, terminate, or redesignate any Account; open any new account intended to be subject to this Agreement; merge or combine any Account; or permit a change to authorized signatories if objected to in writing by Secured Party.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','2.4 Depositor’s Consent. Depositor hereby irrevocably authorizes and consents to Bank’s compliance with all Instructions originated by Secured Party, '),('ins','including all Entitlement Orders,'),('normal',' without any obligation to inquire into Secured Party’s authority or to provide notice to Depositor. Depositor acknowledges that Bank shall have no liability to Depositor for complying with any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with this Agreement.')])
redline_para(d,[('normal','2.5 Depositor’s Operating Rights Prior to Notice of Exclusive Control. Unless and until Bank has received a NOEC, Depositor shall have the '),('del','full and unrestricted right to issue Instructions to Bank with respect to the Accounts, including but not limited to directing the withdrawal, transfer, payment, and disposition of funds in the Accounts in the ordinary course of Depositor’s business, without any requirement of consent or notification to Secured Party'),('ins','right to issue Instructions to Bank with respect to the Accounts in the ordinary course of Depositor’s business. Following Bank’s receipt of a NOEC, Depositor shall have no right to issue Instructions or Entitlement Orders with respect to the affected Accounts, and Bank shall not accept or process any new Depositor Instruction or Entitlement Order'),('. Bank shall have no obligation to inquire whether any Instruction originated by Depositor prior to receipt of a NOEC is consistent with the Loan Documents.')])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 3 — Exclusive Control Upon Event of Default'],1)
redline_para(d,[('del','3.1 Bank Priority. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, Bank’s rights of set-off, recoupment, banker’s lien, and security interest in and against the Accounts shall at all times be prior and superior to any Instructions received from Secured Party and to any Lien or claim of Secured Party in the Accounts.'),('ins','3.1 Depositor’s Rights Prior to NOEC. Prior to delivery of a NOEC, Bank may continue to comply with Instructions originated by Depositor in the ordinary course of business, subject to Bank’s obligations to comply with Secured Party’s Instructions and Entitlement Orders under Section 2.2 and the priority waterfall in Section 4.')])
redline_para(d,[('del','3.2 Conflict Resolution. In the event of any conflict between Bank’s exercise of set-off, recoupment, or lien rights and Instructions received from Secured Party, Bank’s exercise of such rights shall prevail and Bank shall have no liability to Secured Party.'),('ins','3.2 Effect of NOEC. Upon receipt of a NOEC, Bank shall cease complying with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Depositor and shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party, without further consent, authorization, or approval of Depositor.')])
redline_para(d,[('del','3.3 Notice of Exercise. Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to notify Secured Party promptly following any exercise of set-off against the Accounts, but failure to provide such notice shall not affect the validity or priority of such exercise.'),('ins','3.3 No Requirement of Default Verification. Bank shall not require evidence of an Event of Default, a court order, a judgment, a certificate from Depositor, or other documentation as a condition to compliance with a NOEC. Bank’s sole obligation is to verify that the notice is written, purports to come from Secured Party or its authorized representative, is delivered in accordance with Section 10, and directs exclusive compliance with Secured Party’s Instructions and Entitlement Orders.')])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 4 — Conflicting Instructions; Waterfall and Limited Set-Off'],1)
redline_para(d,[('del','4.1 Reservation of Set-Off Rights. Bank reserves and retains the unrestricted right to set off, charge, debit, or apply funds in any Account against any obligation owed to Bank by Depositor, whether direct or contingent, now existing or hereafter arising, whether or not related to the Accounts, and whether matured or unmatured, liquidated or unliquidated, including obligations arising under any loan, credit facility, treasury management service, letter of credit, foreign exchange transaction, interest rate swap, or other agreement between Bank and Depositor.'),('ins','4.1 Priority of Instructions. In the event of any conflict between Instructions or Entitlement Orders received from Secured Party and Instructions received from Depositor, the Instructions and Entitlement Orders of Secured Party shall control and prevail. Depositor’s Instructions shall be followed only to the extent they are not inconsistent with Secured Party’s Instructions or Entitlement Orders and no NOEC is then in effect.')])
redline_para(d,[('del','4.2 No Prior Notice or Consent Required. Bank may exercise such set-off right without prior notice to, or consent of, Secured Party or Depositor.'),('ins','4.2 Notification of Conflicts. Bank shall promptly notify Secured Party of any conflicting or potentially conflicting Depositor Instruction and shall await further direction from Secured Party before acting on a Depositor Instruction that conflicts with a Secured Party Instruction or Entitlement Order, except to the extent delay would cause Bank to violate applicable law.')])
redline_para(d,[('ins','4.3 Limited Set-Off. Notwithstanding Sections 4.1 and 8, Bank may exercise set-off only against direct, matured, and liquidated Bank Obligations arising under the deposit account agreements governing the Accounts, and only for customary account maintenance fees, service charges, and returned, reversed, dishonored, or charged-back items. Bank shall have no right of set-off against the Accounts for any contingent, unmatured, unliquidated, derivative, swap, foreign-exchange, credit-facility, or Affiliate obligation. Any permitted set-off shall remain subject to Secured Party’s priority under Section 4.1 and the subordination provisions of Section 8.')])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 5 — Notice of Exclusive Control; Compliance Period'],1)
redline_para(d,[('normal','5.1 Effect of NOEC. Upon receipt by Bank of a NOEC delivered in accordance with Section 10, Bank shall immediately cease complying with any new Instructions or Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Depositor and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any such new payment orders. Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party. Bank may honor only a Depositor payment order that was originated by Depositor and accepted by Bank before Bank’s receipt of the NOEC and that has not been completed as of receipt, and Bank shall not accept any new Depositor Instructions or Entitlement Orders after receipt of the NOEC.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','5.2 NOEC Compliance Period. Bank shall comply with a NOEC within '),('del','five (5)'),('ins','three (3)'),('normal',' Business Days of receipt thereof. During that period, Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to implement the NOEC as promptly as practicable, and shall not permit new debits, withdrawals, or transfers initiated by Depositor after receipt of the NOEC to be processed from the Accounts.')])
add_redline_body(d,['5.3 No Requirement of Proof. Bank’s sole obligation upon receipt of a NOEC shall be to verify that the notice is written, purports to come from Secured Party or an authorized representative, is directed to Bank in accordance with Section 10, and requests exclusive compliance with Secured Party’s Instructions and Entitlement Orders.'])
add_redline_body(d,['5.4 Depositor’s Waiver. Depositor irrevocably waives any right to challenge Bank’s compliance with a NOEC or any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with this Agreement.'])
add_redline_body(d,['5.5 Rescission of NOEC. A NOEC shall remain in effect until Secured Party delivers a written rescission notice. Upon receipt, Bank shall resume complying with Depositor Instructions in the ordinary course, subject to Section 2.2.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 6 — Indemnification'],1)
add_redline_body(d,['6.1 Secured Party Indemnification. Secured Party agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Bank and its officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from Losses arising out of Bank’s compliance with Secured Party’s Instructions or Entitlement Orders, a NOEC, or any action taken in reliance on this Agreement or related communications.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','6.2 Scope of Indemnification. The indemnification obligations of Secured Party under Section 6.1 shall '),('del','apply regardless of whether such Losses arise in whole or in part from the negligence (including gross negligence) of Bank, and shall be limited only where such Losses are determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in a final, non-appealable judgment to have resulted solely and directly from the willful misconduct of Bank'),('ins','not extend to Losses to the extent determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in a final, non-appealable judgment to have resulted from the gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, or material breach of this Agreement by Bank or the applicable Bank Indemnitee') ,'.'])
add_redline_body(d,['6.3 Depositor Indemnification. Depositor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless each Bank Indemnitee from Losses arising from a breach or inaccuracy by Depositor under this Agreement or a third-party claim relating to the Accounts or funds therein, to the extent the claim does not arise from the acts or omissions of Bank or Secured Party.'])
add_redline_body(d,['6.4 Procedure. An indemnitee shall promptly notify the indemnifying party of a claim, provided failure to notify shall relieve the indemnifying party only to the extent materially prejudiced. The indemnifying party may assume the defense at its cost, subject to separate counsel where a conflict reasonably exists.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 7 — Limitation of Liability'],1)
redline_para(d,[('del','7.1 Aggregate Liability Cap. Bank’s aggregate liability under or in connection with this Agreement, whether arising in contract, tort, strict liability, or otherwise, shall not exceed Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000). The foregoing limitation shall not apply to Losses resulting from Bank’s willful misconduct.'),('ins','7.1 [Reserved; no aggregate liability cap.]')])
add_redline_body(d,['7.2 Mutual Waiver of Consequential, Punitive, and Indirect Damages. NO PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO ANY OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, PUNITIVE, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOST PROFITS, LOSS OF BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY, OR LOSS OF GOODWILL, ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT, WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT, TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE), STRICT LIABILITY, OR ANY OTHER THEORY, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.'])
add_redline_body(d,['7.3 No Duty to Monitor. Bank shall have no duty to monitor the Accounts, verify authority beyond standard authentication procedures, determine whether an Event of Default has occurred, inquire into the propriety of an Instruction, or enforce the Loan Documents.'])
add_redline_body(d,['7.4 Good Faith Reliance. Bank may rely on the genuineness and authority of any communication reasonably believed in good faith to be genuine and transmitted by an authorized person.'])
add_redline_body(d,['7.5 No Fiduciary Duty. Bank acts solely as depository bank and custodian and owes no fiduciary duty except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 8 — Subordination of Bank Liens (Limited)'],1)
redline_para(d,[('normal','8.1 Limited Subordination. Bank agrees to subordinate its Liens in the Accounts solely to the extent of fees, charges, and returned items that have accrued or been incurred during the '),('del','ninety (90)'),('ins','one hundred eighty (180)'),('normal',' day period immediately preceding delivery of a NOEC (the “Lookback Period”); provided that Bank’s Liens with respect to obligations arising prior to the Lookback Period, or accruing after delivery of the NOEC, shall not be subordinated.')])
add_redline_body(d,['8.2 Fees Not Subject to Subordination. Bank’s standard published account maintenance and service fees and returned items may be charged only as permitted by Section 4.3 and this Section 8. All other fees and reimbursements, including legal-fee reimbursement, shall remain subject to the subordination and priority provisions of this Agreement.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 9 — Successor Bank; Notification Obligations; Termination'],1)
redline_para(d,[('ins','9.1 Successor Bank; Notification. Bank shall not merge, consolidate, transfer substantially all of its deposit-taking operations or assets, or transfer the Accounts to a successor depository institution without providing Secured Party at least thirty (30) days’ prior written notice of the proposed transaction. Bank shall cause any successor bank to assume in writing the obligations of Bank under this Agreement and shall cooperate in executing a replacement control agreement so that there is no gap in perfection.')])
add_redline_body(d,['9.2 Termination by Secured Party. This Agreement may be terminated upon the prior written consent of Secured Party, delivered to Bank and Depositor in accordance with Section 10. Any purported termination without such consent shall be void.'])
add_redline_body(d,['9.3 Secured Party’s Obligation to Consent to Termination. Secured Party shall consent promptly, and in any event within ten (10) Business Days, after indefeasible payment in full of the Secured Obligations, termination of commitments, and release of the related security interests.'])
add_redline_body(d,['9.4 No Unilateral Termination by Depositor. Depositor may not unilaterally terminate this Agreement, and Bank shall not give effect to such request without Secured Party’s written consent.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','9.5 Bank Termination. Bank may terminate this Agreement, in its sole discretion, upon '),('del','thirty (30)'),('ins','ninety (90)'),('normal',' days’ prior written notice to Secured Party and Depositor; provided that during the notice period Secured Party shall have the express right to transition the Accounts to a replacement depository bank, Bank shall cooperate fully with that transition, and Bank’s termination shall not become effective until a replacement depository bank and replacement control agreement acceptable to Secured Party have been identified and executed and control over the Accounts has been perfected.')])
add_redline_body(d,['9.6 Survival. Sections 6, 7, 8, 9.1, and 10 shall survive termination to the extent applicable.'])

redline_para(d,[('normal','10.1 Governing Law. redline_para(d,[('normal','10.3 Waiver of Jury Trial. EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.')])
add_redline_body(d,['10.4 Amendments. No amendment, modification, supplement, restatement, or waiver shall be effective unless in a written instrument executed and delivered by each of the three Parties.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.5 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with the Schedules attached hereto, constitutes the entire agreement among the Parties with respect to its subject matter.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.6 Severability. If any provision is invalid or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, the remaining provisions remain effective, and the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to preserve the original intent.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.7 Counterparts; Electronic Execution. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature to the extent permitted by applicable law, including E-SIGN and the New York Electronic Signatures and Records Act.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.8 Successors and Assigns. This Agreement binds the Parties and permitted successors and assigns. Depositor may not assign without Secured Party consent; Secured Party may assign its rights under the Loan Documents without consent of Depositor or Bank.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.9 No Third-Party Beneficiaries. This Agreement is for the benefit of the Parties and their permitted successors and assigns only.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.10 Headings. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.'])

redline_para(d,[('normal','12.2 Representations and Warranties of Depositor. redline_para(d,[('normal','12.2(a) No Prior Control Agreements or Liens. redline_para(d,[('del','3.3 Notice of Exercise. redline_para(d,[('del','4.1 Reservation of Set-Off Rights. redline_para(d,[('del','4.2 No Prior Notice or Consent Required. redline_para(d,[('ins','4.3 Limited Set-Off. add_redline_heading(d,['Section 5 — Notice of Exclusive Control; Compliance Period'],1)
redline_para(d,[('normal','5.1 Effect of NOEC. redline_para(d,[('normal','5.2 NOEC Compliance Period. Bank shall comply with a NOEC within '),('del','five (5)'),('ins','three (3)'),('normal',' Business Days of receipt thereof. add_redline_body(d,['5.3 No Requirement of Proof. add_redline_body(d,['5.4 Depositor’s Waiver. Depositor irrevocably waives any right to challenge Bank’s compliance with a NOEC or any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with this Agreement.'])
add_redline_body(d,['5.5 Rescission of NOEC. A NOEC shall remain in effect until Secured Party delivers a written rescission notice. Upon receipt, Bank shall resume complying with Depositor Instructions in the ordinary course, subject to Section 2.2.'])

redline_para(d,[('normal','6.2 Scope of Indemnification. add_redline_body(d,['6.3 Depositor Indemnification. redline_para(d,[('del','7.1 Aggregate Liability Cap. add_redline_body(d,['7.4 Good Faith Reliance. Bank may rely on the genuineness and authority of any communication reasonably believed in good faith to be genuine and transmitted by an authorized person.'])
add_redline_body(d,['7.5 No Fiduciary Duty. Bank acts solely as depository bank and custodian and owes no fiduciary duty except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 8 — Subordination of Bank Liens (Limited)'],1)
redline_para(d,[('normal','8.1 Limited Subordination. add_redline_body(d,['8.2 Fees Not Subject to Subordination. redline_para(d,[('ins','9.1 Successor Bank; Notification. Bank shall cause any successor bank to assume in writing the obligations of Bank under this Agreement and shall cooperate in executing a replacement control agreement so that there is no gap in perfection.')])
add_redline_body(d,['9.2 Termination by Secured Party. This Agreement may be terminated upon the prior written consent of Secured Party, delivered to Bank and Depositor in accordance with Section 10. Any purported termination without such consent shall be void.'])
add_redline_body(d,['9.3 Secured Party’s Obligation to Consent to Termination. add_redline_body(d,['9.4 No Unilateral Termination by Depositor. Depositor may not unilaterally terminate this Agreement, and Bank shall not give effect to such request without Secured Party’s written consent.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','9.5 Bank Termination. add_redline_body(d,['9.6 Survival. Sections 6, 7, 8, 9.1, and 10 shall survive termination to the extent applicable.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 10 — Governing Law; Jurisdiction; Miscellaneous'],1)
redline_para(d,[('normal','10.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of '),('del','North Carolina'),('ins','New York'),(', without regard to conflict-of-laws principles that would require application of another jurisdiction’s laws. redline_para(d,[('normal','10.2 Jurisdiction; Venue. redline_para(d,[('normal','10.3 Waiver of Jury Trial. EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.')])
add_redline_body(d,['10.4 Amendments. No amendment, modification, supplement, restatement, or waiver shall be effective unless in a written instrument executed and delivered by each of the three Parties.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.5 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with the Schedules attached hereto, constitutes the entire agreement among the Parties with respect to its subject matter.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.6 Severability. If any provision is invalid or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, the remaining provisions remain effective, and the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to preserve the original intent.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.7 Counterparts; Electronic Execution. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature to the extent permitted by applicable law, including E-SIGN and the New York Electronic Signatures and Records Act.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.8 Successors and Assigns. This Agreement binds the Parties and permitted successors and assigns. Depositor may not assign without Secured Party consent; Secured Party may assign its rights under the Loan Documents without consent of Depositor or Bank.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.9 No Third-Party Beneficiaries. This Agreement is for the benefit of the Parties and their permitted successors and assigns only.'])
add_redline_body(d,['10.10 Headings. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.'])

add_redline_heading(d,['Section 11 — Fees and Expenses'],1)
add_redline_body(d,['11.1 Annual Maintenance Fee. Depositor shall pay Bank an annual account control agreement maintenance fee of Three Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($3,500) per Account per annum, currently three Accounts for a total annual fee of Ten Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($10,500), payable in advance on the Effective Date and each anniversary thereof.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','11.2 Legal-Fee Reimbursement. Depositor shall reimburse Bank for Bank’s documented, reasonable, out-of-pocket outside legal costs incurred in connection with the review, negotiation, and execution of this Agreement in an amount equal to the '),('del','Fifteen Thousand Dollars ($15,000)'),('ins','lesser of (a) Seven Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($7,500) and (b) the actual documented, reasonable, out-of-pocket legal fees incurred by Bank'),('normal',', payable upon execution. Such reimbursement may be debited from the Operating Account upon effectiveness, subject to Section 8.')])
redline_para(d,[('del','11.3 Priority of Fees. All fees and reimbursements payable under this Section 11 shall constitute Bank Obligations and shall be entitled to priority under Section 3 and shall not be subject to subordination under Section 8.'),('ins','11.3 Priority of Fees. add_redline_heading(d,['Section 12 — Representations and Warranties'],1)
add_redline_body(d,['12.1 Representations and Warranties of Bank. Bank represents and warrants to Secured Party and Depositor, as of the Effective Date and each date this Agreement remains in effect, that it is duly organized and authorized to enter into and perform this Agreement; each Account is held in Depositor’s name; Bank is a “bank” under UCC Section 9-102(a)(8); and this Agreement is a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Bank.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','12.1(a) No Other Control Agreements. '),('del','[Bank Turn 1 deleted this representation.]'),('ins','Bank has not entered into, and covenants that it will not enter into, any control agreement, blocked account agreement, escrow agreement, or similar arrangement with respect to any Account granting control to any Person other than Secured Party without Secured Party’s prior written consent.')])

'),('del','[Bank Turn 1 deleted this representation.]'),('ins','Bank has received no notice of any Lien, claim, interest, or adverse claim in or to the Accounts other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party contemplated hereby, and Bank is not aware of any pending or threatened claim affecting the Accounts.')])
redline_para(d,[('normal','12.2 Representations and Warranties of Depositor. Depositor represents and warrants that it is the sole and exclusive legal and beneficial owner of the Accounts and all funds therein, free and clear of all Liens other than the Lien of Secured Party; that it has full authority to enter into this Agreement; and that this Agreement is a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Depositor.'])
redline_para(d,[('normal','12.2(a) No Prior Control Agreements or Liens. '),('del','Depositor has not granted control of, or any Lien on, the Accounts (or any funds therein) to any person or entity other than Secured Party.'),('ins','Depositor has not granted control of, or any Lien on, the Accounts (or any funds therein) to any Person other than Secured Party, and there are no prior or existing control agreements, blocked account agreements, notices of lien, tax levies, garnishments, or adverse claims affecting the Accounts other than this Agreement.')])

c=base_doc('Cover Note – Second-Turn Counter-Redline')
# header identity
p=para(c,'HARGRAVE STEIN & COLLIER LLP',style='Title',align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT); p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(0)
para(c,'787 Seventh Avenue, 40th Floor | New York, NY 10019',italic=True)
para(c,'May 9, 2025')
para(c,'Via Email')
para(c,'Lena Marchetti and Reginald Stowe\nBlackmere Fox LLP\n301 South College Street, Suite 3200\nCharlotte, NC 28202')
para(c,'Re: Ironbridge / Graycliff / Pinnacle — Deposit Account Control Agreement (Bank Turn 1 / Pinnacle Turn 2)\nBlackmere Fox Ref. BF-IRB-25-00893 | Hargrave Stein Matter No. 2025-HSC-04417',bold=True)
para(c,'Dear Lena and Reginald:')
para(c,'On behalf of Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC (“Pinnacle”), we attach Pinnacle’s second-turn counter-redline of the Deposit Account Control Agreement covering Graycliff Industries, Inc.’s three deposit accounts at Ironbridge National Bank, N.A. (accounts ending 4471, 4472, and 4473). The approximate aggregate controlled balance is $38,150,000. We have reviewed Ironbridge’s May 5, 2025 markup and have addressed each of the substantive changes identified in your transmittal. Our comments below are intended to facilitate a prompt path to execution well before the May 30, 2025 delivery and perfection deadline under Section 6.14(b) of the Credit Agreement.')
para(c,'Pinnacle’s positions are as follows:')

items=[
('1. Entitlement-order terminology (§ 2(a)).','We have restored “Entitlement Order” terminology alongside the Article 9 “Instruction” terminology. This is deliberate: the agreement should preserve the Article 8 control framework if an Account is characterized as a securities account, while also satisfying the Article 9 tripartite-agreement method. The dual-track formulation is intended to ensure that the Bank’s agreement to follow Secured Party directions is effective without further Depositor consent and without ambiguity as to UCC Article 8 control.'),
('2. Springing exclusive control and ordinary-course operation (§ 2).','Pinnacle accepts the concept that Graycliff may operate the Accounts in the ordinary course before a Notice of Exclusive Control (“NOEC”) is delivered. We have clarified the boundary that is essential to the control arrangement: upon the Bank’s receipt of an NOEC, Graycliff may not issue or continue to issue new directions, and the Bank must comply exclusively with Pinnacle’s directions without a Depositor-consent condition. This preserves ordinary-course functionality while making the post-NOEC lock-down unqualified.'),
('3. Conflicting-instructions waterfall and Bank priority (§ 3).','We have rejected the proposed priority for Bank set-off and liens over Pinnacle’s directions. In a conflict, Pinnacle’s Instructions and Entitlement Orders must prevail. That priority is central to the control arrangement and to the UCC framework: the Bank’s authenticated agreement to follow the Secured Party’s directions is the basis for control under UCC § 9-104(a)(2).'),
('4. Set-off scope (§ 4).','As a good-faith accommodation, Pinnacle has narrowed the Bank’s set-off rights rather than insisting on an absolute waiver. The permitted carve-out is limited to direct, matured, liquidated obligations arising under the deposit account agreements themselves—customary account fees, service charges, and returned or reversed items. It excludes contingent, unmatured, unliquidated, derivative, swap, foreign-exchange, credit-facility, and Affiliate obligations. Any permitted set-off remains subject to Pinnacle’s priority and the subordination provisions.'),
('5. NOEC compliance period (§ 5).','We have countered the proposed five-business-day period with three Business Days. This is a reasonable middle ground between the two-business-day period in Pinnacle’s form and Ironbridge’s five-business-day request. It gives the Bank a meaningful operational window while limiting the period during which funds could be dissipated after an NOEC.'),
('6. Indemnification / gross negligence (§ 6).','The proposed indemnification for the Bank’s own gross negligence is rejected. Pinnacle has restored the customary carve-outs for gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, and material breach. A secured party should not be required to indemnify a depository bank for losses caused by the bank’s own gross negligence; that allocation is consistent with market practice for control agreements.'),
('7. Aggregate liability cap (§ 7(a)).','The proposed $50,000 aggregate cap has been deleted. The three controlled Accounts hold approximately $38.15 million, so a $50,000 cap would be de minimis in relation to the collateral at risk and would provide no meaningful accountability for a control failure. Pinnacle cannot accept that cap in its current form.'),
('8. Consequential-damages waiver (§ 7(b)).','We have left the mutual consequential, punitive, incidental, and indirect damages waiver in place for this turn, subject to Pinnacle’s reservation of rights and the resolution of the remaining Section 7 issues. Pinnacle is not making a separate objection to a properly mutual waiver in principle, but the waiver should not be viewed as curing or replacing the deleted liability cap or as limiting direct losses arising from a failure to honor the control mechanics.'),
('9. Bank-lien subordination / lookback (§ 8).','We have changed the proposed 90-day Lookback Period to 180 days. A shorter period would leave an unacceptable gap in the subordination protection during which older Bank claims could prime the Secured Party’s interest in the Accounts. We have also conformed the fee language so that only the expressly permitted ordinary-course items receive the limited carve-out.'),
('10. Termination rights (§ 9).','Pinnacle continues to prefer termination only with Secured Party consent. As a practical counter-proposal to the Bank’s unilateral termination right, the redline provides for at least 90 days’ prior written notice and expressly permits Pinnacle to transition the Accounts to a replacement depository bank during that period. Ironbridge must cooperate, and termination should not become effective until replacement control documentation is executed and control is perfected. A 30-day unilateral termination right could create an avoidable gap in perfection.'),
('11. Governing law and related forum provisions (§ 10).','We have restored New York law and the related New York forum provision. New York law governs the Credit Agreement and provides a well-developed body of authority concerning UCC Articles 8 and 9 control arrangements. The provision separately recognizes that mandatory local-law rules governing perfection and priority under UCC § 9-304 will control where applicable.'),
('12. No prior control agreements or liens (§ 12).','We have reinstated the representations addressing prior control agreements, liens, and adverse claims, together with the forward-looking covenant not to enter into another control arrangement without Pinnacle’s consent. This confirmation is critical to Pinnacle’s first-priority control analysis. A public UCC search will not identify a competing control agreement, so the Bank’s representation is an important protection against an undisclosed competing arrangement.'),
('13. Successor-bank notification (§ 9.1).','We have reinstated an obligation to provide at least 30 days’ prior written notice of any merger, consolidation, transfer of substantially all deposit-taking operations or assets, or transfer of the Accounts to a successor bank. The Bank must also cause the successor to assume the ACA obligations and cooperate in executing replacement control documentation. This notice is necessary to preserve continuity of the control arrangement and avoid a perfection gap.'),
]

para(c,'Pinnacle accepts the annual maintenance fee of $3,500 per Account ($10,500 in the aggregate for the three Accounts). Graycliff’s counsel is copied so that the ordinary-course operating and limited set-off formulations can be confirmed promptly. We would appreciate Ironbridge’s review on an expedited basis given the May 30 deadline and the need to leave sufficient time for execution and perfection evidence.')
para(c,'Please let us know if a call would be helpful. We are prepared to work constructively toward a final form and believe the attached markup narrows the remaining issues while protecting the essential control and perfection mechanics.')
para(c,'Best regards,')
para(c,'/s/ Priya Nagarajan\nPriya Nagarajan\nHargrave Stein & Collier LLP\nCounsel to Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC')
para(c,'cc: Catherine Voss, Dunlevy Rourke LLP (counsel to Graycliff Industries, Inc.)\n    Diana Whitford, Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC\n    Jonathan Kehoe, Ironbridge National Bank, N.A.')

13: # **DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT**
14: 
15: This DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into as of \[DATE\], 2025 (the "Effective Date"), by and among the following parties:
16: 
17: SECURED PARTY: Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, and its successors and assigns (the "Secured Party");
18: 
19: DEPOSITOR / DEBTOR: Graycliff Industries, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Depositor" or "Debtor"); and
20: 
21: DEPOSITORY BANK: Ironbridge National Bank, N.A., a national banking association (the "Bank").
22: 
23: Each of the Secured Party, the Depositor, and the Bank is sometimes referred to herein individually as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties."
24: 
25: # **RECITALS**
26: 
27: WHEREAS, Depositor maintains the deposit accounts identified on Schedule A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (collectively, the "Accounts" and each individually, an "Account");
28: 
29: WHEREAS, Secured Party has been granted a security interest in, and lien upon, the Accounts and all funds and proceeds credited thereto pursuant to that certain Credit Agreement dated as of April 14, 2025, with a maturity date of April 14, 2030, and the related Loan Documents;
30: 
31: WHEREAS, the Parties desire to establish "control" (as such term is defined and used in Articles 8 and 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of New York) by the Secured Party over the Accounts in order to perfect the security interest of the Secured Party therein;
32: 
33: WHEREAS, Bank is willing to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.
34: 
35: NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, representations, and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:
36: 
37: # **Section 1 --- Definitions**
38: 
39: As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Loan Documents or, if not defined therein, in the UCC.
40: 
41: "Account" or "Deposit Account" means each deposit account identified on Schedule A hereto, including any and all renewals, replacements, or successor accounts thereof, and all funds, cash, instruments, investment property, and other property at any time credited to, deposited in, held in, or otherwise attributable to any such account, together with all interest, income, earnings, and proceeds thereof.
42: 
43: "Bank Obligations" means only direct, matured, and liquidated obligations owed by Depositor to Bank arising under the deposit account agreements governing the Accounts, consisting solely of customary account fees, service charges, and returned or reversed items, and excluding any contingent, unmatured, unliquidated, derivative, swap, foreign-exchange, credit-facility, or Affiliate obligation.
44: 
45: "Business Day" means any day on which Bank is open for the conduct of substantially all of its commercial banking business at its offices in New York, New York, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and any day on which banking institutions in the State of New York are authorized or required by law or executive order to close.
46: 
47: "Entitlement Order" has the meaning ascribed to such term in UCC Section 8-102(a)(8), and includes any notification communicated to Bank directing the transfer, redemption, liquidation, or other disposition of a financial asset or interest therein, including any entitlement order originated by Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement.
48: 
49: "Event of Default" means an "Event of Default" as defined in, and determined in accordance with, the Loan Documents, or as otherwise notified by Secured Party to Bank pursuant to a Notice of Exclusive Control. Bank shall have no obligation or duty to independently determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents.
50: 
51: "Exclusive Control Notice" or "Notice of Exclusive Control" (each, a "NOEC") means a written notice delivered by Secured Party to Bank in accordance with Section 5 hereof, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A (if any), asserting that an Event of Default has occurred under the Loan Documents and directing Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, and to cease complying with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor.
52: 
53: "Instructions" means any order, direction, instruction, request, or authorization regarding the disposition of funds in, or any other action to be taken or omitted with respect to, any Account.
54: 
55: "Lien" means any security interest, lien, charge, encumbrance, claim, right of set-off, banker's lien, or other interest or right of any kind, whether arising by contract, operation of law, or otherwise.
56: 
57: "Loan Documents" means, collectively, the credit agreement, loan agreement, security agreement, and all related agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents between or among Depositor and Secured Party, as amended, restated, supplemented, replaced, refinanced, or otherwise modified from time to time.
58: 
59: "UCC" means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of New York; provided that, to the extent that mandatory law governs perfection, effect of perfection or non-perfection, or priority in another jurisdiction, the UCC of that jurisdiction shall apply solely for those purposes.
60: 
61: # **Section 2 --- The Accounts; Establishment of Control**
62: 
63: 2.1 Confirmation of Accounts. Bank hereby confirms and acknowledges that (a) each Account listed on Schedule A is maintained at Bank, (b) each Account is held in the name of Depositor as account holder of record, (c) each Account constitutes a "deposit account" and/or "securities account" (as applicable) within the meaning of the UCC, and (d) Bank is the "bank" within the meaning of UCC Section 9-102(a)(8) with respect to each Account.
64: 
65: 2.2 Establishment of Control. Bank hereby agrees that, from and after the Effective Date, it will comply with Entitlement Orders and Instructions originated by Secured Party directing the disposition of funds in the Accounts without further consent of Depositor, thereby establishing "control" by Secured Party over the Accounts within the meaning of UCC Sections 9-104(a)(2) and 8-106 (to the extent applicable). Such compliance obligation is unconditional and shall not be subject to any condition other than delivery in accordance with Section 10. The Parties intend that this Agreement satisfy all requirements for control and perfection under the UCC.
66: 
67: 2.3 No Changes to Accounts Without Consent. Bank shall not, without the prior written consent of Secured Party, change the name, account number, title, designation, or ownership of any Account; close, terminate, or redesignate any Account; open any new account intended to be subject to this Agreement; merge or combine any Account; or permit a change to authorized signatories if objected to in writing by Secured Party.
68: 
69: 2.4 Depositor's Consent. Depositor hereby irrevocably authorizes and consents to Bank's compliance with all Instructions originated by Secured Party, including all Entitlement Orders, without any obligation to inquire into Secured Party's authority or to provide notice to Depositor. Depositor acknowledges that Bank shall have no liability to Depositor for complying with any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with this Agreement.
70: 
71: 2.5 Depositor's Operating Rights Prior to Notice of Exclusive Control. Unless and until Bank has received a NOEC, Depositor shall have the right to issue Instructions to Bank with respect to the Accounts in the ordinary course of Depositor's business. Following Bank's receipt of a NOEC, Depositor shall have no right to issue Instructions or Entitlement Orders with respect to the affected Accounts, and Bank shall not accept or process any new Depositor Instruction or Entitlement Order. Bank shall have no obligation to inquire whether any Instruction originated by Depositor prior to receipt of a NOEC is consistent with the Loan Documents.
72: 
73: # **Section 3 --- Exclusive Control Upon Event of Default**
74: 
75: 3.1 Depositor's Rights Prior to NOEC. Prior to delivery of a NOEC, Bank may continue to comply with Instructions originated by Depositor in the ordinary course of business, subject to Bank's obligations to comply with Secured Party's Instructions and Entitlement Orders under Section 2.2 and the priority waterfall in Section 4.
76: 
77: 3.2 Effect of NOEC. Upon receipt of a NOEC, Bank shall cease complying with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Depositor and shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party, without further consent, authorization, or approval of Depositor.
78: 
79: 3.3 No Requirement of Default Verification. Bank shall not require evidence of an Event of Default, a court order, a judgment, a certificate from Depositor, or other documentation as a condition to compliance with a NOEC. Bank's sole obligation is to verify that the notice is written, purports to come from Secured Party or its authorized representative, is delivered in accordance with Section 10, and directs exclusive compliance with Secured Party's Instructions and Entitlement Orders.
80: 
81: # **Section 4 --- Conflicting Instructions; Waterfall and Limited Set-Off**
82: 
83: 4.1 Priority of Instructions. In the event of any conflict between Instructions or Entitlement Orders received from Secured Party and Instructions received from Depositor, the Instructions and Entitlement Orders of Secured Party shall control and prevail. Depositor's Instructions shall be followed only to the extent they are not inconsistent with Secured Party's Instructions or Entitlement Orders and no NOEC is then in effect.
84: 
85: 4.2 Notification of Conflicts. Bank shall promptly notify Secured Party of any conflicting or potentially conflicting Depositor Instruction and shall await further direction from Secured Party before acting on a Depositor Instruction that conflicts with a Secured Party Instruction or Entitlement Order, except to the extent delay would cause Bank to violate applicable law.
86: 
87: 4.3 Limited Set-Off. Notwithstanding Sections 4.1 and 8, Bank may exercise set-off only against direct, matured, and liquidated Bank Obligations arising under the deposit account agreements governing the Accounts, and only for customary account maintenance fees, service charges, and returned, reversed, dishonored, or charged-back items. Bank shall have no right of set-off against the Accounts for any contingent, unmatured, unliquidated, derivative, swap, foreign-exchange, credit-facility, or Affiliate obligation. Any permitted set-off shall remain subject to Secured Party's priority under Section 4.1 and the subordination provisions of Section 8.
88: 
89: # **Section 5 --- Notice of Exclusive Control; Compliance Period**
90: 
91: 5.1 Effect of NOEC. Upon receipt by Bank of a NOEC delivered in accordance with Section 10, Bank shall immediately cease complying with any new Instructions or Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Depositor and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any such new payment orders. Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party. Bank may honor only a Depositor payment order that was originated by Depositor and accepted by Bank before Bank's receipt of the NOEC and that has not been completed as of receipt, and Bank shall not accept any new Depositor Instructions or Entitlement Orders after receipt of the NOEC.
92: 
93: 5.2 NOEC Compliance Period. Bank shall comply with a NOEC within three (3) Business Days of receipt thereof. During that period, Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to implement the NOEC as promptly as practicable, and shall not permit new debits, withdrawals, or transfers initiated by Depositor after receipt of the NOEC to be processed from the Accounts.
94: 
95: 5.3 No Requirement of Proof. Bank's sole obligation upon receipt of a NOEC shall be to verify that the notice is written, purports to come from Secured Party or an authorized representative, is directed to Bank in accordance with Section 10, and requests exclusive compliance with Secured Party's Instructions and Entitlement Orders.
96: 
97: 5.4 Depositor's Waiver. Depositor irrevocably waives any right to challenge Bank's compliance with a NOEC or any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with this Agreement.
98: 
99: 5.5 Rescission of NOEC. A NOEC shall remain in effect until Secured Party delivers a written rescission notice. Upon receipt, Bank shall resume complying with Depositor Instructions in the ordinary course, subject to Section 2.2.
100: 
101: # **Section 6 --- Indemnification**
102: 
103: 6.1 Secured Party Indemnification. Secured Party agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Bank and its officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from Losses arising out of Bank's compliance with Secured Party's Instructions or Entitlement Orders, a NOEC, or any action taken in reliance on this Agreement or related communications.
104: 
105: 6.2 Scope of Indemnification. The indemnification obligations of Secured Party under Section 6.1 shall not extend to Losses to the extent determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in a final, non-appealable judgment to have resulted from the gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, or material breach of this Agreement by Bank or the applicable Bank Indemnitee.
106: 
107: 6.3 Depositor Indemnification. Depositor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless each Bank Indemnitee from Losses arising from a breach or inaccuracy by Depositor under this Agreement or a third-party claim relating to the Accounts or funds therein, to the extent the claim does not arise from the acts or omissions of Bank or Secured Party.
108: 
109: 6.4 Procedure. An indemnitee shall promptly notify the indemnifying party of a claim, provided failure to notify shall relieve the indemnifying party only to the extent materially prejudiced. The indemnifying party may assume the defense at its cost, subject to separate counsel where a conflict reasonably exists.
110: 
111: # **Section 7 --- Limitation of Liability**
112: 
113: 7.1 \[Reserved; no aggregate liability cap.\]
114: 
115: 7.2 Mutual Waiver of Consequential, Punitive, and Indirect Damages. NO PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO ANY OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, PUNITIVE, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES, INCLUDING LOST PROFITS, LOSS OF BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY, OR LOSS OF GOODWILL, ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT, WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT, TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE), STRICT LIABILITY, OR ANY OTHER THEORY, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
116: 
117: 7.3 No Duty to Monitor. Bank shall have no duty to monitor the Accounts, verify authority beyond standard authentication procedures, determine whether an Event of Default has occurred, inquire into the propriety of an Instruction, or enforce the Loan Documents.
118: 
119: 7.4 Good Faith Reliance. Bank may rely on the genuineness and authority of any communication reasonably believed in good faith to be genuine and transmitted by an authorized person.
120: 
121: 7.5 No Fiduciary Duty. Bank acts solely as depository bank and custodian and owes no fiduciary duty except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.
122: 
123: # **Section 8 --- Subordination of Bank Liens (Limited)**
124: 
125: 8.1 Limited Subordination. Bank agrees to subordinate its Liens in the Accounts solely to the extent of fees, charges, and returned items that have accrued or been incurred during the one hundred eighty (180) day period immediately preceding delivery of a NOEC (the "Lookback Period"); provided that Bank's Liens with respect to obligations arising prior to the Lookback Period, or accruing after delivery of the NOEC, shall not be subordinated.
126: 
127: 8.2 Fees Not Subject to Subordination. Bank's standard published account maintenance and service fees and returned items may be charged only as permitted by Section 4.3 and this Section 8. All other fees and reimbursements, including legal-fee reimbursement, shall remain subject to the subordination and priority provisions of this Agreement.
128: 
129: # **Section 9 --- Successor Bank; Notification Obligations; Termination**
130: 
131: 9.1 Successor Bank; Notification. Bank shall not merge, consolidate, transfer substantially all of its deposit-taking operations or assets, or transfer the Accounts to a successor depository institution without providing Secured Party at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice of the proposed transaction. Bank shall cause any successor bank to assume in writing the obligations of Bank under this Agreement and shall cooperate in executing a replacement control agreement so that there is no gap in perfection.
132: 
133: 9.2 Termination by Secured Party. This Agreement may be terminated upon the prior written consent of Secured Party, delivered to Bank and Depositor in accordance with Section 10. Any purported termination without such consent shall be void.
134: 
135: 9.3 Secured Party's Obligation to Consent to Termination. Secured Party shall consent promptly, and in any event within ten (10) Business Days, after indefeasible payment in full of the Secured Obligations, termination of commitments, and release of the related security interests.
136: 
137: 9.4 No Unilateral Termination by Depositor. Depositor may not unilaterally terminate this Agreement, and Bank shall not give effect to such request without Secured Party's written consent.
138: 
139: 9.5 Bank Termination. Bank may terminate this Agreement, in its sole discretion, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Secured Party and Depositor; provided that during the notice period Secured Party shall have the express right to transition the Accounts to a replacement depository bank, Bank shall cooperate fully with that transition, and Bank's termination shall not become effective until a replacement depository bank and replacement control agreement acceptable to Secured Party have been identified and executed and control over the Accounts has been perfected.
140: 
141: 9.6 Survival. Sections 6, 7, 8, 9.1, and 10 shall survive termination to the extent applicable.
142: 
143: # **Section 10 --- Governing Law; Jurisdiction; Miscellaneous**
144: 
145: 10.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles that would require application of another jurisdiction's laws. Matters relating to perfection, priority, and enforcement of security interests in the Accounts shall be determined under the UCC applicable pursuant to UCC Section 9-304.
146: 
147: 10.2 Jurisdiction; Venue. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York and the Supreme Court of the State of New York, County of New York (Borough of Manhattan), and any appellate courts thereof, for any action arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and waives any objection to venue or inconvenient forum.
148: 
149: 10.3 Waiver of Jury Trial. EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.
150: 
151: 10.4 Amendments. No amendment, modification, supplement, restatement, or waiver shall be effective unless in a written instrument executed and delivered by each of the three Parties.
152: 
153: 10.5 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with the Schedules attached hereto, constitutes the entire agreement among the Parties with respect to its subject matter.
154: 
155: 10.6 Severability. If any provision is invalid or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, the remaining provisions remain effective, and the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to preserve the original intent.
156: 
157: 10.7 Counterparts; Electronic Execution. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature to the extent permitted by applicable law, including E-SIGN and the New York Electronic Signatures and Records Act.
158: 
159: 10.8 Successors and Assigns. This Agreement binds the Parties and permitted successors and assigns. Depositor may not assign without Secured Party consent; Secured Party may assign its rights under the Loan Documents without consent of Depositor or Bank.
160: 
161: 10.9 No Third-Party Beneficiaries. This Agreement is for the benefit of the Parties and their permitted successors and assigns only.
162: 
163: 10.10 Headings. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.
164: 
165: # **Section 11 --- Fees and Expenses**
166: 
167: 11.1 Annual Maintenance Fee. Depositor shall pay Bank an annual account control agreement maintenance fee of Three Thousand Five Hundred Dollars (\$3,500) per Account per annum, currently three Accounts for a total annual fee of Ten Thousand Five Hundred Dollars (\$10,500), payable in advance on the Effective Date and each anniversary thereof.
168: 
169: 11.2 Legal-Fee Reimbursement. Depositor shall reimburse Bank for Bank's documented, reasonable, out-of-pocket outside legal costs incurred in connection with the review, negotiation, and execution of this Agreement in an amount equal to the lesser of (a) Seven Thousand Five Hundred Dollars (\$7,500) and (b) the actual documented, reasonable, out-of-pocket legal fees incurred by Bank, payable upon execution. Such reimbursement may be debited from the Operating Account upon effectiveness, subject to Section 8.
170: 
171: 11.3 Priority of Fees. Fees and reimbursements payable under this Section 11 shall be subject to Sections 4.3 and 8, except for customary account maintenance fees and returned items expressly permitted thereunder.
172: 
173: # **Section 12 --- Representations and Warranties**
174: 
175: 12.1 Representations and Warranties of Bank. Bank represents and warrants to Secured Party and Depositor, as of the Effective Date and each date this Agreement remains in effect, that it is duly organized and authorized to enter into and perform this Agreement; each Account is held in Depositor's name; Bank is a "bank" under UCC Section 9-102(a)(8); and this Agreement is a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Bank.
176: 
177: 12.1(a) No Other Control Agreements. Bank has not entered into, and covenants that it will not enter into, any control agreement, blocked account agreement, escrow agreement, or similar arrangement with respect to any Account granting control to any Person other than Secured Party without Secured Party's prior written consent.
178: 
179: 12.1(b) No Other Liens or Claims. Bank has received no notice of any Lien, claim, interest, or adverse claim in or to the Accounts other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party contemplated hereby, and Bank is not aware of any pending or threatened claim affecting the Accounts.
180: 
181: 12.2 Representations and Warranties of Depositor. Depositor represents and warrants that it is the sole and exclusive legal and beneficial owner of the Accounts and all funds therein, free and clear of all Liens other than the Lien of Secured Party; that it has full authority to enter into this Agreement; and that this Agreement is a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Depositor.
182: 
183: 12.2(a) No Prior Control Agreements or Liens. Depositor has not granted control of, or any Lien on, the Accounts (or any funds therein) to any Person other than Secured Party, and there are no prior or existing control agreements, blocked account agreements, notices of lien, tax levies, garnishments, or adverse claims affecting the Accounts other than this Agreement.
